name: Wing A: manual and hydraulic wing valves (pump-down side)
function: The pair of wing valves on the cross outlet facing the zipper side: a manual valve inboard as the isolation barrier and a hydraulic valve outboard as the working valve, serving the pump-down or kill line.

tabs.overview: Two valves in series on the same outlet. The inboard manual valve stays open during the job and is closed only for repairs on the outboard valve or the line. The outboard hydraulic valve is the one cycled from the control unit: opened for pump-down fluid during wireline runs or for a kill line, closed while pumping the treatment.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic gate valve; commonly the most cycled valve on the stack and the first to show seat wear.
tabs.safety: Fully open or fully closed only. Pumping against a closed frac wing raises pressure to the relief valve set point and trips the pumps.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.
